text.p: Latvian radio reported the following headlines in its early afternoon news report:
- The general prosecutor's office will release its report on the corruption scandal next week, saying which ministers broke anti-corruption laws by having state and business posts at the same time.

- Prime Minister Andris Shkele says he will make no announcements on the future of his government until the report has been released. Shkele has said that if the report says some of his ministers broke anti-corruption laws then the government may step down.
